title: Decision Sufficiency of Learned Representation Interfaces for Safe Generative Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.27446v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A controller can guide a language model toward safe and useful responses by choosing when to assist, ask for clarification, or refuse. When the controller uses selected internal features, poor performance alone cannot distinguish missing information from limitations of its decision rules or training. We study decision sufficiency: whether the best controller using a representation can match the minimum average loss attainable with full state information, under the same strategies and evaluation criteria. For interfaces with finitely many outputs, we compute the optimal loss exactly and separate the three sources of excess loss. Pairwise checks can miss information loss: states with the same controller input may share an optimal strategy in every pair but not across the whole group. We bound the number of states needed to reveal a conflict and characterize the fewest outputs an unrestricted interface needs to avoid all conflicts. We audit

translated_title: 面向安全生成式控制的学习型表征接口的决策充分性
translated_abstract: 控制器可以通过选择何时提供帮助、何时请求澄清或何时拒绝，来引导语言模型产生安全且有用的响应。当控制器使用选定的内部特征时，仅凭糟糕的性能表现无法区分是信息缺失还是其决策规则或训练的局限性所致。我们研究决策充分性：即在相同策略和评估标准下，使用某种表征的最佳控制器能否达到利用完整状态信息所能获得的最小平均损失。对于输出数量有限的接口，我们精确计算了最优损失，并分离出超额损失的三种来源。成对检验可能会漏掉信息损失：具有相同控制器输入的状态可能在每一对之间共享最优策略，但在整个组内却并非如此。我们给出了揭示冲突所需状态数量的界限，并刻画了无限制接口为避免所有冲突所需的最少输出数量。我们审计了（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出“决策充分性”概念，用以评估学习型表征接口是否为安全生成式控制器提供了足够的信息，精确分离了超额损失的三种来源，并刻画了揭示信息冲突所需的状态数量及接口避免冲突所需的最少输出。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the notion of "decision sufficiency" to evaluate whether learned representation interfaces provide enough information for safe generative controllers, exactly separating excess loss into three sources, bounding the number of states needed to reveal conflicts, and characterizing the fewest outputs required to avoid all conflicts.
